title: Minty roast veg and hummus salad
instructions: Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Peel the parsnips and cut them and the carrots into wedges, drain the chickpeas, and drain and cut the beetroot into wedges.
Toss the parsnips, carrots, cumin seeds and chickpeas with the oil and seasoning in a large roasting tin. Roast for 30 minutes, tossing halfway.
Add the beetroot, drizzle over the honey and return to the oven for 10 minutes.

Spread the hummus thinly over a platter or four plates. Drizzle the vinegar over the roast veg and toss in the tin, then tip onto the hummus. Scatter with the mint leaves and crumbled cheese, pour over any tin juices and serve.
